cases.prompt: Review this test packaging and execution plan.
cases.context: The skill stores production scripts in scripts/, script tests in tests/, and behavior cases in tests/cases.json. Its scripts/run-tests.ps1 recursively runs every fixture and sends prompts to a paid agent.
expectations: Requires the runner to execute top-level script tests without discovering nested fixture scripts as test entry points.
Rejects model calls in routine script testing and keeps behavioral execution explicitly requested.
